interface.name: xwayland_satellite_interaction_v1

description.summary: optional cancellation of an accepted interactive operation

interface.description: Experimental, private extension for an X11 compatibility bridge. Absence leaves xdg-shell move/resize available, without cancellation forwarding. The compositor may restrict this global to its authenticated bridge. This extension does not grant authority to start an interaction.

request.name: cancel

description.summary: stop geometry changes for this exact interaction

request.description: Cancel only a currently active move or resize previously accepted from this toplevel, seat and initiating input serial. Unknown, stale, rejected or completed operations are ignored. Retain the geometry reached so far, including anchoring of outstanding resize buffers. Remaining buttons or touch contacts stay owned by the cancelled sequence until they drain; cancellation must not deliver an unmatched release to another surface.

arg.name: serial
arg.summary: serial used for the accepted xdg-shell move or resize
